events.event: Black Mountain College was founded.
events.quote: And, in the end, there were only four of us who started...

events.event: Frank Rice attended Black Mountain College as a student.
events.source: Harris interview with Frank Aydelotte Rice (116_120_Frank_Aydelotte_Rice_1917-2007.txt)
events.quote: So, I went to — What would have been my senior year I spent studying at the college...

events.event: Norman Betts Weston moved from Rollins College to Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: So, I went to Black Mountain and showed up—actually drove down with Nan, Peggy Loram, and Ed Jenks.

events.event: Norman Betts Weston started the farm at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: Well, I had something to do with starting the farm, but we never referred to it as a garden.

events.event: Josef Albers arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: I think my first vivid memory was standing on the steps of Lee Hall with everybody else in the community as Ted Dreier drove up from the station with the Albers.

events.event: Norman Betts Weston bought a Buick Roadster.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: I bought it for a hundred dollars. I’m not quite sure where I got the hundred dollars. It was a Buick Roadster.

events.event: Norman Betts Weston worked on the farm and borrowed a mule from Bob Morehead.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: And we borrowed—I remember borrowing the mule from Morehead—Bob Morehead, who lived next door.

events.event: Norman Betts Weston became assistant treasurer at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: Well, I had the title of assistant treasurer.

events.event: John Dewey visited Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Norman Betts Weston (148_155_Norman_Norm_Betts_Weston_1913-2000_and_Anne_Nan_Howard_Chapi.txt)
events.quote: Oh, yes. I remember—The main thing I remember is going down to Black Mountain with John Dewey.

events.event: Elizabeth Young Williams arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: My parents drove me down, and I guess my first impression was of that great enormous reception room there.

events.event: Albers arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: I think he came right after Thanksgiving, early December.

events.event: Community meeting about sheets on beds.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: I remember the one about the sheets on the bed.

events.event: Community meeting about Zora Hurston's visit.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: Then there was the one about Zora Hurston.

events.event: Ted Shawn dancers visited Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: Do you remember the Ted Shawn dancers? Sure. Very well.

events.event: Thornton Wilder visited Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: Thornton Wilder was a great one, because he participated in everything and was very warm and friendly.

events.event: Elizabeth Young Williams participated in a play written by John Rice.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth Young Williams (154_163_Mary_Elizabeth_Betty_Young_Williams_b_1914.txt)
events.quote: Do you remember a play that Rice wrote? Um-hm [AFFIRMATIVE], I was in it.

events.event: Jacqueline was born in Paris, France.
events.source: Harris interview with Jacqueline Herrmann Gourevitch (164_173_Jacqueline_Herrmann_Gourevitch_b_1933.txt)
events.quote: I was born in Paris. I was born in France in 1933...

events.event: Frances de Graaff came to America.
events.source: Harris interview with Franziska 'Frances' de Graaff (031_30_Franziska_Frances_de_Graaff_1904-1997.txt)
events.quote: I came to America in '39, when the war threatened in Holland.

events.event: Started school at Black Mountain College
events.quote: I started school here at Black Mountain in the fall of '39.

events.event: William McCleery returned to Black Mountain College for the spring term.
events.quote: Then he invited me to come back, or the college invited me to come back, and spend the spring term.

events.quote: Well, anyway, that play they took to the Carolina Dramatic Festival and won a first prize.

events.quote: I wrote the book and the lyrics, and he wrote the music.

events.event: Bernard Malek arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Bernard Joseph Malek (163_172_Bernard_Joseph_Malek_1920-2007.txt)
events.quote: The atmosphere in 1939, I guess it was, at Black Mountain College was very — was hypersexual.

events.event: Bernard Malek participated in a production of 'John Gabriel Borkman'.

events.quote: John Gabriel Borkman. That was the first one.

events.event: Marian Nacke Teeter left Black Mountain College.

events.quote: It must have been 1936, and then I left in 1939.

events.event: Visited Black Mountain College with her mother.
events.source: Harris interview with Marjorie Borden Moench (186_195_Marjorie_Borden_Moench_1923-2017.txt)
events.quote: So, we took a trip down to Black Mountain. I guess it was in '39.

events.event: Nan spent the summer on the Isle of Wight when World War II was declared.

events.event: Robert de Niro, Sr. studied with Hans Hofmann.
events.source: Harris interview with Robert de Niro, Sr. (032_31_Robert_de_Niro_Sr_1922-1993.txt)
events.quote: And then I went to Black Mountain and then back to Hofmann.

events.event: Robert de Niro, Sr. attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Robert de Niro, Sr. (032_31_Robert_de_Niro_Sr_1922-1993.txt)
events.quote: I had his studio. That was to me the proof that he was—I mean, I remember that very clearly.

events.event: German invasion of Norway.
events.source: Harris interview with Antonie 'Toni' Landau Dehn (033_32_Antonie_Toni_Landau_Dehn_1893-1996.txt)
events.quote: We were there when the Germans came.

events.event: Max Dehn was offered a position at the University of Idaho.
events.source: Harris interview with Antonie 'Toni' Landau Dehn (033_32_Antonie_Toni_Landau_Dehn_1893-1996.txt)
events.quote: On the 4th of July we got a telegram offering my husband a position at the University of Idaho in Pocatello, Idaho.

events.event: Construction began on the new Studies Building at Lake Eden.
events.source: Harris interview with Theodore Dreier, Jr. (035_36_Theodore_Dreier_Jr_1929-2019.txt)
events.quote: They were starting to build a new Studies Building over there.

events.event: Meeting at the Museum of Modern Art to raise funds.
events.location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
events.quote: The meeting at the Museum of Modern Art was in January 1940.

events.event: Brewster Elledge left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Brewster Elledge (039_40_Harvey_Brewster_Elledge_1918-1996.txt)
events.quote: You left Black Mountain in 19— '40.

events.event: Roosevelt gave a speech assuring mothers their sons would not go to war.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Brewster Elledge (039_40_Harvey_Brewster_Elledge_1918-1996.txt)
events.quote: I heard the Roosevelt speech after lunch, sitting out on that little cul-de-sac behind the Dining Hall.

events.event: Foundations for a building were being worked on at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Brewster Elledge (039_40_Harvey_Brewster_Elledge_1918-1996.txt)
events.quote: They were just working on the foundations.

events.event: Brewster Elledge performed a clown act at a civic building in Black Mountain.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Brewster Elledge (039_40_Harvey_Brewster_Elledge_1918-1996.txt)
events.quote: He said, 'They're having an amateur contest at some civic building, downtown Black Mountain.'

events.event: Alvin Eisenman hung an exhibition of Albers’ lithographs at Dartmouth.
events.quote: I had hung an exhibition of Albers’ lithographs at Dartmouth in 1940 and had been dazzled by his work.

events.event: Mary Gregory sold and repurchased her 1935 Ford for $350.
events.quote: I bought the 1935 Ford for 350 dollars, and I sold it to Ben Snead... I bought it back from him for 350 dollars!

events.event: Will Hamlin transferred to Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Wilfrid "Will" Gardiner Hamlin (056_57_Wilfrid_Will_Gardiner_Hamlin_1918-2009.txt)
events.quote: So, in the fall of 1940 I went to Black Mountain...

events.event: Germans marched into Denmark.
events.source: Harris interview with Erik Christian Haugaard (057_58_Erik_Christian_Haugaard_1923-2009.txt)
events.quote: the 9th of April the Germans marched into Denmark.

events.event: Peter Hill attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Peter Jack Robbins Hill (066_67_Peter_Pete_Jack_Robbins_Hill_1922-2017.txt)
events.quote: '40, Fall of '40 to the Winter of '42. I went into my third year, and then was drafted.

events.event: Larry's family arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Lawrence "Larry" Taylor Kocher (077_78_Lawrence_Larry_Taylor_Kocher_1936_-2019_and_Sandra_Ann_Koche.txt)
events.quote: They came in 1940 and I was born in '36.

events.event: Saw Merce Cunningham dance at Bennington College
events.quote: I had seen Merce dance in the summer of 1940 at Bennington College.

events.event: Dick Carpenter died shortly after leaving Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Harold Bradford Raymond (114_118_Harold_Bradford_Raymond_1919-2008.txt)
events.quote: Carpenter died very young, while he was still at Black Mountain, as a matter of fact.

events.event: Morris Simon applied to Black Mountain College using $300 from his father's insurance policy.
events.source: Harris interview with Morris Leon Simon (130_134_Morris_Leon_Simon_1918-2001.txt)
events.quote: I used the $300 that I got from my father’s insurance policy to pay the minimum amount for the education at Black Mountain in 1940.

events.event: Zoya Sandomirsky Slive arrived in the United States from Europe.
events.source: Harris interview with Zoya Sandomirsky Slive (132_136_Zoya_Sandomirsky_Slive_1924-2021.txt)
events.quote: I was fifteen years old when I came to this country. This was in 1940.

events.event: Zoya attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Zoya Sandomirsky Slive (132_136_Zoya_Sandomirsky_Slive_1924-2021.txt)
events.quote: I went off to Black Mountain.

events.event: Zoya left Black Mountain College to return to Chicago.
events.source: Harris interview with Zoya Sandomirsky Slive (132_136_Zoya_Sandomirsky_Slive_1924-2021.txt)
events.quote: I came back and maybe two or three days later I left.

events.event: Zoya attended the University of Chicago.
events.source: Harris interview with Zoya Sandomirsky Slive (132_136_Zoya_Sandomirsky_Slive_1924-2021.txt)
events.quote: I went to the University of Chicago and I finished yet another experimental program.

events.event: Sybil worked as a waitress at Lake Eden.
events.source: Harris interview with Sybil Eleanor Yamins (Goldberg) (153_162_Sybil_Eleanor_Yamins_Goldberg_1920-2018.txt)
events.quote: I stayed down and worked as a waitress over at Lake Eden.

events.event: Frank Nacke drowned.
events.source: Harris interview with Sybil Eleanor Yamins (Goldberg) (153_162_Sybil_Eleanor_Yamins_Goldberg_1920-2018.txt)
events.quote: That was the summer that Frank Nacke was drowned.

events.event: Frances Kuntz died and her ashes were placed in the Brooklyn Botanical Gardens.
events.source: Harris interview with Bernard Joseph Malek (163_172_Bernard_Joseph_Malek_1920-2007.txt)
events.quote: No. About two years ago she died. She’s now inhabiting the Brooklyn Botanical Gardens as dust.

events.event: Jacqueline moved to New York City from Europe.
events.source: Harris interview with Jacqueline Herrmann Gourevitch (164_173_Jacqueline_Herrmann_Gourevitch_b_1933.txt)
events.quote: I came to this country in 1940 and grew up in New York City...

events.event: First year at Black Mountain College, stayed in Lee Hall.

events.author: Janet Heling

events.event: Peggy Bennett Cole attended Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I think it was the fall of 1944, '44-'45, because I remember when Roosevelt died, I was there.

events.event: Addison Bray and Barbara Anderson were expelled from Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Addison Sargent Bray (016_15_Addison_Sargent_Bray_1923-2012.txt)
events.quote: Andy and I – Barbara Anderson and I – had been thrown out at the beginning of that.

events.event: Incident involving hitchhiking and arrest of students.
events.source: Harris interview with Mary Brett Daniels (017_16_Mary_Brett_Daniels_b_1922.txt)
events.quote: The summer of '44.

events.event: Black Mountain College accepted their first Black student.
events.quote: 1944, they accepted their first Black student and then they accepted several.

events.event: Marcel Dick participated in a music institute at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: That summer was one of those major splits that Black Mountain was known for.

events.event: A concert was planned to reach the general public, including Asheville.
events.quote: Towards the end of the summer a concert was announced, concert was planned, to reach general public from surrounding areas, including Asheville.

events.event: Schoenberg's First Quartet was rehearsed and performed.
events.quote: We prepared for performance—for one of these performances—Schoenberg's First Quartet, the D minor quartet, Opus 7.

events.event: A black female student was admitted to Black Mountain College.
events.quote: They did accept one young lady, colored, and who was a delightful companion.

events.event: Communist issues arose at BMC.
events.quote: Oh, the Communists. Oh, well, that came toward the end of the time we were here.

events.event: Gwendolyn Currier Jamieson left BMC during the 'big split' in protest.
events.source: Harris interview with Gwendolyn Currier Jamieson (071_72_Gwendolyn_Currier_Jamieson_1921-1999.txt)
events.quote: I left during the big split – in protest.

events.event: The great Music Institute took place at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Gwendolyn Currier Jamieson (071_72_Gwendolyn_Currier_Jamieson_1921-1999.txt)
events.quote: Then, of course, we had the great music institute, which you know about—very exciting, extraordinarily exciting—and the Graudans came, Nikolai and Johanna Graudan.

events.event: Integration issue at BMC with the admission of Alma Stone.
events.source: Harris interview with Gwendolyn Currier Jamieson (071_72_Gwendolyn_Currier_Jamieson_1921-1999.txt)
events.quote: First, the summer of ‘44, the great Music institute... Then we had our first Negro student then.

events.event: Alfred Kazin taught courses on Blake and Melville at BMC.
events.quote: I gave one course on Blake, which is—and then I gave a course in Melville, Moby Dick, really.

events.event: Alfred Kazin left BMC to go overseas.
events.quote: I went overseas at the very end of '44.

events.event: Open rehearsals of the Schoenberg Quartet were inaugurated.
events.source: Harris interview with Lorna Freedman Kolisch (078_79_Lorna_Freedman_Kolisch_1917-2006.txt)
events.quote: Well, he inaugurated them—open rehearsals, which, of course, had been done since then very often, and we did the first Schoenberg Quartet.

events.event: Performance of the Schoenberg Quartet at Black Mountain College.
events.location: Dining hall area, Black Mountain College
events.source: Harris interview with Lorna Freedman Kolisch (078_79_Lorna_Freedman_Kolisch_1917-2006.txt)
events.quote: As I remember the performance, it was, was incredibly good.

events.event: Opera workshop conducted by Jalowetz with Cohen.
events.source: Harris interview with Lorna Freedman Kolisch (078_79_Lorna_Freedman_Kolisch_1917-2006.txt)
events.quote: There was an opera workshop, right.

events.event: Ruth Lyford Sussler attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Lyford Sussler (090_91_Mary_Ruth_Lyford_Sussler_1928-2020.txt)
events.quote: Summer of 1944, in the depth of World War Two.

events.event: Ruth Lyford Sussler participated in a fresco project under Jean Charlot.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Lyford Sussler (090_91_Mary_Ruth_Lyford_Sussler_1928-2020.txt)
events.quote: We did a fresco project on one of the pillars or the pilings under the Study Building.

events.event: Ruth Lyford Sussler took courses with Josef Albers and Jean Charlot.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Lyford Sussler (090_91_Mary_Ruth_Lyford_Sussler_1928-2020.txt)
events.quote: I took Albers’s course in Drawing. Matière. Well, the drawing was life drawing. Then I took drawing with Charlot.

events.event: Ursula Lewis Mamlok attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Ursula Lewis Mamlok (092_93_Ursula_Lewis_Mamlok_1923-2016.txt)
events.quote: I was in Black, at Black Mountain College through reading an article in the New York Times.

events.event: Schoenberg's 70th birthday was celebrated with concerts at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Ursula Lewis Mamlok (092_93_Ursula_Lewis_Mamlok_1923-2016.txt)
events.quote: They celebrated it by playing Schoenberg for concerts, and rehearsing it every day.

events.event: Ursula Lewis Mamlok received a scholarship to attend BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Ursula Lewis Mamlok (092_93_Ursula_Lewis_Mamlok_1923-2016.txt)
events.quote: I did get a scholarship. I sent some compositions in.

events.event: Roger Sessions visited BMC and later became Mamlok's teacher.
events.source: Harris interview with Ursula Lewis Mamlok (092_93_Ursula_Lewis_Mamlok_1923-2016.txt)
events.quote: Roger Sessions came, and he later became my teacher.

events.event: Concert of Ursula Lewis Mamlok's music at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Ursula Lewis Mamlok (092_93_Ursula_Lewis_Mamlok_1923-2016.txt)
events.quote: I remember prepare a concert of my own music.

events.event: Ruth Miller Currier left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Miller Currier (099_100_Ruth_Miller_Currier_1926-2011.txt)
events.quote: But they were sort of like what we call in the university now, 'service classes'.

events.event: Ruth Miller Currier attended the first summer institute at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Miller Currier (099_100_Ruth_Miller_Currier_1926-2011.txt)
events.quote: I only attended one summer at Black Mountain, one summer institute, which was the first, I believe, in 1944.

events.event: Conflict at Black Mountain College regarding the admission of black students.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Miller Currier (099_100_Ruth_Miller_Currier_1926-2011.txt)
events.quote: The second year you were there was the year of the tremendous conflict—

events.event: Alfred Kazin taught a class on Blake and Melville.
events.quote: MEH: That would have been the fall of ’44. MP: Could be.

events.event: Max Paul participated in a Greek play directed by Robert Wunsch.
events.quote: MP: We put on a Greek play—Aristophanes or one of them.

events.event: Max Paul was the fire chief at BMC and organized a fire drill.
events.quote: MP: I was the fire chief there for a while.

events.event: Jeanne Wacker was arrested for hitchhiking in Chattanooga.
events.source: Harris interview with Jeanne Claire Louise Wacker (Sobran) (142_148_Jeanne_Claire_Louise_Wacker_Sobran_1922-2017.txt)
events.quote: We were arrested for hitchhiking. and we were thrown into the clink.

events.event: Eric Bentley taught at Fisk University.
events.source: Harris interview with Jeanne Claire Louise Wacker (Sobran) (142_148_Jeanne_Claire_Louise_Wacker_Sobran_1922-2017.txt)
events.quote: Since our favorite teacher had gone to teach for summer school at Fisk University in Nashville...

events.event: Jeanne Wacker and others left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Jeanne Claire Louise Wacker (Sobran) (142_148_Jeanne_Claire_Louise_Wacker_Sobran_1922-2017.txt)
events.quote: Then all those people decided to leave because of Fran.

events.event: Judd Woldin enrolled at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Edwin Judd Woldin (151_158_Edwin_Judd_Woldin_1925-2011.txt)
events.quote: You went to Black Mountain in the fall of '44? JW: Right.

events.event: Nancy Smith Wright attended Black Mountain College for the first time.

events.event: Lorna Blaine Halper attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Lorna Blaine Howard Halper (010_10_Lorna_Blaine_Howard_Halper_1924-2020.txt)
events.quote: Then it wasn't til 1945, as I told you before, that I persuaded my parents.

events.event: Fire drill initiated by Angelica Bodky Lee's father, followed by a fire in the chemistry lab.
events.source: Harris interview with Angelica Bodky Lee (012_11_Angelica_Bodky_Lee_1929-2012.txt)
events.quote: He brought up the subject in a student-faculty thing. So they did. They had a fire drill. That night the chemistry lab burned down.

events.event: Florence studied music with Heinrich Jalowetz.
events.source: Harris interview with Florence Fogelson Blumberg (042_45_Florence_Fogelson_Blumberg_1927-1998.txt)
events.quote: I studied with Mr. Jalowetz – Heinrich – but only for a few months Then he died.

events.event: Florence participated in chorus and worked on the Brahms Requiem.
events.source: Harris interview with Florence Fogelson Blumberg (042_45_Florence_Fogelson_Blumberg_1927-1998.txt)
events.quote: But also we had chorus and we were working on the Brahms Requiem.

events.event: Florence lived in the lodge at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Florence Fogelson Blumberg (042_45_Florence_Fogelson_Blumberg_1927-1998.txt)
events.quote: Well, I lived in the lodge.

events.event: Florence participated in a girls' basketball team.
events.source: Harris interview with Florence Fogelson Blumberg (042_45_Florence_Fogelson_Blumberg_1927-1998.txt)
events.quote: I organized a girls' basketball team.

events.event: Florence was involved in a Thanksgiving football game.
events.source: Harris interview with Florence Fogelson Blumberg (042_45_Florence_Fogelson_Blumberg_1927-1998.txt)
events.quote: I remember that we organized a wonderful cheering squad.

events.event: Hannelore Hahn attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Hannelore Hahn Stouman (054_55_Hannelore_Hahn_Stouman_b_1926.txt)
events.quote: I was there, and whatever I was supposed to do, I would try to do.

events.event: Hannelore Hahn participated in a community service project at a mental hospital.
events.source: Harris interview with Hannelore Hahn Stouman (054_55_Hannelore_Hahn_Stouman_b_1926.txt)
events.quote: I became – I mean it was left up to me to make those connections.

events.event: Hannelore Hahn took art classes from Josef Albers.
events.source: Harris interview with Hannelore Hahn Stouman (054_55_Hannelore_Hahn_Stouman_b_1926.txt)
events.quote: I took art from Josef Albers.

events.event: Jene Markoff Witte attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Jene Markoff Witte (094_95_Jene_Markoff_Magilnik_Witte_b_1925.txt)
events.quote: And you were at Black Mountain, according to my records for two years, from 1945 to 1947.

events.event: Jene Markoff Witte studied writing with M.C. Richards.
events.source: Harris interview with Jene Markoff Witte (094_95_Jene_Markoff_Magilnik_Witte_b_1925.txt)
events.quote: With whom did you study writing? JM: M.C. Richards.

events.event: Jene Markoff Witte drove a truck as part of the work program at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Jene Markoff Witte (094_95_Jene_Markoff_Magilnik_Witte_b_1925.txt)
events.quote: I took one look at the heavy work they were doing, and promptly learned to drive the truck.

events.event: A radio series on Thomas Wolfe was scripted by Jene Markoff Witte and another student.
events.source: Harris interview with Jene Markoff Witte (094_95_Jene_Markoff_Magilnik_Witte_b_1925.txt)
events.quote: We interviewed the brother, and we did a whole radio series on Thomas Wolfe.

events.event: Students participated in farm work and maintenance tasks.
events.source: Harris interview with Carol Rita Serling (Greenberg) (128_132_Carol_Rita_Serling_Greenberg_1927-2018.txt)
events.quote: We did a lot of farm work.

events.event: Construction of the Study House and use of army barracks.
events.source: Harris interview with Carol Rita Serling (Greenberg) (128_132_Carol_Rita_Serling_Greenberg_1927-2018.txt)
events.quote: During the time I was there, we built the Study House.

events.event: Coal was transported from Asheville to the college.
events.source: Harris interview with Carol Rita Serling (Greenberg) (128_132_Carol_Rita_Serling_Greenberg_1927-2018.txt)
events.quote: We were responsible for going into Asheville, into the yards, and loading the coal.

events.event: Vera Baker Williams took courses at BMC including a Bible course with Eddie Lowinsky, philosophy with Dr. Dehn, art, and German.
events.source: Harris interview with Vera Baker Williams (150_157_Vera_Baker_Williams_1927-2015.txt)
events.quote: Well that first year I was there I took a course in the Bible.

events.event: Lore Kadden Lindenfeld took design and color courses with Josef Albers at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Lore Kadden Lindenfeld (159_168_Lore_Kadden_Lindenfeld_1921-2010.txt)
events.quote: These first studies that I have here I made during a time when I took the design and color course with Josef Albers.

events.event: Dorothy Cole Ruddick attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Dorothy Cole Ruddick (165_174_Dorothy_Lawrence_Cole_Ruddick_1925-2010.txt)
events.quote: I remember during my two years, which sandwiched one summer, of being there...

events.event: Great hey-day at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with David Hudson Corkran (171_180_David_Hudson_Corkran_b_1935.txt)
events.quote: The great hey-day in the college had been between 1945 and 1949.

events.event: Laurie attended Black Mountain College for one year.
events.source: Harris interview with Laurie Rose Mattlin (Morgenstern) (188_197_Laurie_Rose_Mattlin_Morgenstern_1926-2020.txt)
events.quote: Honey, I only went for a year.

events.event: Studied art with Josef Albers and majored in psychology and art.
events.source: Harris interview with Laurie Rose Mattlin (Morgenstern) (188_197_Laurie_Rose_Mattlin_Morgenstern_1926-2020.txt)
events.quote: I studied art with Josef Albers... And I majored in psychology and art.

events.event: Rode a farmer's horse around the grounds of BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Laurie Rose Mattlin (Morgenstern) (188_197_Laurie_Rose_Mattlin_Morgenstern_1926-2020.txt)
events.quote: I used to ride a farmer’s horse around the grounds.

events.quote: So we played a recital at Black Mountain College, and I think I played one myself.

events.quote: in '46, '47, '48—those are the years that I remember best—there was a kind of split in the student body

events.event: David Schauffler attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with David Craig Schauffler (169_178_David_Dave_Craig_Schauffler_1928-2014.txt)
events.quote: It was the year of 1946-47.

events.event: David Schauffler participated in a chorus directed by Eddie Lowinsky.
events.source: Harris interview with David Craig Schauffler (169_178_David_Dave_Craig_Schauffler_1928-2014.txt)
events.quote: I immediately joined the chorus that Eddie Lowinsky directed.

events.event: David Schauffler sang in a group led by Louis Selders.
events.source: Harris interview with David Craig Schauffler (169_178_David_Dave_Craig_Schauffler_1928-2014.txt)
events.quote: I sang with a guy named Louis Selders, who was a black student there.

events.event: David Schauffler participated in the Work Program at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with David Craig Schauffler (169_178_David_Dave_Craig_Schauffler_1928-2014.txt)
events.quote: The Work Program to me was one of the most exciting parts of the whole place.

events.event: Richard Amero attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Richard William Amero (181_190_Richard_William_Amero_1924-2012.txt)
events.quote: I went during that 1946-47 period when I understand there was a great influx of GIs...

events.event: Richard Amero performed as Pierrot in Aria Da Capo directed by Arthur Penn.
events.source: Harris interview with Richard William Amero (181_190_Richard_William_Amero_1924-2012.txt)
events.quote: Arthur Penn got ahold of me for Aria Da Capo, and I think that that was probably at Black Mountain the climax of my experience.

events.event: Richard Amero gave a talk on life at the monastery.
events.source: Harris interview with Richard William Amero (181_190_Richard_William_Amero_1924-2012.txt)
events.quote: I gave my beautiful uplifting talk on life at the monastery...

events.event: Jacob Lawrence taught at Black Mountain College Summer Institute.
events.quote: I was invited to visit Black Mountain, to teach there at the Summer Institute, by Josef Albers.

events.event: Jacob Lawrence traveled to Black Mountain College by train.
events.quote: How did you get there? By train.

events.event: Jacob Lawrence stayed in a room on campus with other faculty.
events.quote: In one of the rooms on campus. What would they call them? One of the rooms that we had at the college, with the rest of the faculty.

events.event: A Greek party was held at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: But I remember that party. It was a fabulous party, and like the people were very creative.

events.event: Anne and Josef Albers granted a sabbatical leave.

events.event: Charles Bell was invited to Black Mountain College by Erich Kahler.
events.source: Harris interview with Charles G. Bell (004_4_Charles_G_Bell_1916-2010.txt)
events.quote: It was Erich Kahler who was going to Black Mountain that summer (1947) and arranged for me to come along.

events.event: Galway Kinnell followed Charles Bell to Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Charles G. Bell (004_4_Charles_G_Bell_1916-2010.txt)
events.quote: Galway Kinnell, who had come down, who had followed me from Princeton to be with me...

events.event: Charles Bell taught courses on Chaucer, Spenser, Milton, and a lecture course on the Development of the Arts since the Middle Ages.
events.source: Harris interview with Charles G. Bell (004_4_Charles_G_Bell_1916-2010.txt)
events.quote: The courses you were teaching at Black Mountain... Chaucer, Spenser, Milton, and... Development of the Arts since the Middle Ages.

events.event: Max Dehn taught a philosophy course at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Charles G. Bell (004_4_Charles_G_Bell_1916-2010.txt)
events.quote: Max Dehn was good at raising the philosophic questions from metaphysics to ethics...

events.event: A Wasserman test was required for working in the kitchen at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Charles G. Bell (004_4_Charles_G_Bell_1916-2010.txt)
events.quote: It was a state law that you couldn't work in the kitchen without having a Wasserman test.

events.event: Lorna Blaine Howard Halper married Tasker Howard.
events.source: Harris interview with Lorna Blaine Howard Halper (009_9_Lorna_Blaine_Howard_Halper_1924-2012.txt)
events.quote: We got married in '47.

events.event: A power struggle occurred between Theodore Dreier and Albert William Levi.
events.quote: And this precipitated a real power struggle between those two people...

events.event: Arshile Gorky committed suicide.
events.quote: I was with her when he committed suicide. It was that summer.

events.event: Kendall Durant Ramsay arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Kendall Durant Ramsay (038_39_Kendall_Durant_Ramsey_1929-2010.txt)
events.quote: In the fall of 1947. I think Carol Singer and I came together...

events.event: Albert William Levi gave a talk as Rector at the beginning of school.
events.source: Harris interview with Albert William Levi (085_86_Albert_William_Bill_Levi_1911-1988.txt)
events.quote: It's the talk that I gave as Rector at the beginning of school in 1947.

events.event: Josef Albers visited New York, staying at Clark Foreman's apartment.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Lyford Sussler (090_91_Mary_Ruth_Lyford_Sussler_1928-2020.txt)
events.quote: He was visiting—was that Ati and Charles, or Clark Foreman?

events.event: Arthur Penn directed three one-act plays.
events.source: Harris interview with Arthur Hiller Penn (112_116_Arthur_Hiller_Penn_19222010.txt)
events.quote: Now in the fall of '77—in the spring of '47, you produced the three plays, the three one-act plays?

events.event: Arthur Penn worked in summer theatre as a stage manager.
events.source: Harris interview with Arthur Hiller Penn (112_116_Arthur_Hiller_Penn_19222010.txt)
events.quote: I went off to a job in the theatre. I had to get some money. Where did I go? I went to Falmouth? Martha's Vineyard.

events.event: Frank Rice returned to Black Mountain College as a teacher.
events.source: Harris interview with Frank Aydelotte Rice (116_120_Frank_Aydelotte_Rice_1917-2007.txt)
events.quote: I went back, you know, as a teacher, in '47...

events.event: Daniel Stacey Rice left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Daniel Stacey Rice (117_120a_Daniel_Stacey_Rice_1926-2003.txt)
events.quote: DSR: I stayed until – through the ’47 semester.

events.event: Carol Singer Kalbfeld arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Carol Harriet Singer (Kalbfeld) (131_135_Carol_Harriet_Singer_Kalbfeld_1929-2008.txt)
events.quote: We got there. It was overnight —and I must say that I was very shocked when I got out of the train...

events.event: Mirande Geissbuhler Holl arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Mirande Geissbuhler Holl (143_149_Mirande_Roxanne_Geissbuhler_Holl_b_1928.txt)
events.quote: I think it was 1947. I went in January or February...

events.event: Mirande Geissbuhler Holl took courses with John Wallen, Levy, Howard Rondthaler, and Bolotowsky.
events.source: Harris interview with Mirande Geissbuhler Holl (143_149_Mirande_Roxanne_Geissbuhler_Holl_b_1928.txt)
events.quote: I took John Wallen's courses. I took Levy’s, something from Howard Rondthaler, and then I took drawing from Bolotowsky.

events.event: Mirande Geissbuhler Holl worked on the farm and became the milk maiden.
events.source: Harris interview with Mirande Geissbuhler Holl (143_149_Mirande_Roxanne_Geissbuhler_Holl_b_1928.txt)
events.quote: I worked on the farm, and I became the milk maiden.

events.event: Mirande Geissbuhler Holl participated in the Work Program, driving the tractor and handling coal.
events.source: Harris interview with Mirande Geissbuhler Holl (143_149_Mirande_Roxanne_Geissbuhler_Holl_b_1928.txt)
events.quote: I worked on the Work Program with the coal. I did all those things. I drove the tractor.

events.event: Mirande Geissbuhler Holl attended a concert by Merce Cunningham and John Cage.
events.source: Harris interview with Mirande Geissbuhler Holl (143_149_Mirande_Roxanne_Geissbuhler_Holl_b_1928.txt)
events.quote: I remember when Merce Cunningham and John Cage came.

events.event: Mary Phelan Outten Bowles left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Mary Phelan Outten Bowles (173_182_Mary_Phelan_Outten_Bowles_1927-2015.txt)
events.quote: By the end of the spring in 1947, my father was tired of paying for this.

events.event: Eve had a miscarriage.
events.source: Harris interview with Eve Carinne Zhitlowsky Milton (194_203_Eve_Carinne_Zhitlowsky_Milton_1920-2009.txt)
events.quote: I had a miscarriage in 1947.

events.event: Albert Lanier visited Black Mountain College for the first time.
events.quote: That was in – probably in the spring of 1947.

events.event: Albert Lanier enrolled at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I came in the fall.

events.event: Début Summer Session (1948-49)
First concert of the Summer Session 1948, Piano Recital by Erwin Bodky
events.details: The concert included works by Bach, Busoni, Haydn, Beethoven, Bartok, and Chopin.

events.event: Second Concert of the Summer Session
events.details: Performance of Trio for Piano Violin and Cello in G Major Op.1 No.2, Sonata for Cello and Piano in E Minor Op.38, and 'Dumky' Trio for Piano Violin and Cello.

events.event: Fourth concert of the Black Mountain College Summer Session 1948
events.details: Performance of works by Beethoven, Copland, and Mendelssohn.

events.event: A series of faculty and Board meetings took place where Rondthaler resigned as treasurer and Dreier announced he might leave the college.
events.quote: In a series of faculty and Board meetings at the end of August 1948 (just before the Levis left for Europe), Rondthaler, Levi’s chief ally, resigned as treasurer, and Dreier, who had temporarily taken over as rector in June after Levi’s resignation, announced that he was no longer willing to bear that responsibility—and even suggested that he, too, might want to leave the college for good.

events.event: John Bridges visited BMC after living in Alaska.
events.quote: I lived in Alaska '48-'49, and I remember I still had an Alaska license plate...

events.event: Nick Cernovich attended Black Mountain College.
Nick Cernovich took courses with Josef Albers.
events.quote: NC: I did. I took the drawing course and the color course...

events.event: Nick Cernovich was involved in the Light Sound Movement Workshop.
events.quote: NC: There was something that Pete and Betty [Jennerjahn] had organized...

events.event: Peter Heinemann took courses from Josef Albers and Erwin Bodky.
events.quote: I took only two courses from Albers – Color and Drawing. I took Music Appreciation from a man named Erwin Bodky.

events.event: Peter Heinemann painted approximately 100 paintings at BMC.
events.quote: So, I painted. I think I painted a hundred paintings there.

events.event: Peter Heinemann worked on the farm at BMC.
events.quote: I worked on the farm. I shoveled manure and got the cows in from the fields.

events.event: Ted Dreier was voted off the Board of Fellows.
events.quote: Dreier was voted off the Board of Fellows.

events.event: Felix Krowinski studied various subjects including German, sociology, English literature, American literature, philosophy, and physics.
events.source: Harris interview with Felix Thomas Krowinski (079_80_Felix_Thomas_Krowinski_1921-2004.txt)
events.quote: There was sociology. I took English literature. American literature.

events.event: Felix Krowinski participated in a football game at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Felix Thomas Krowinski (079_80_Felix_Thomas_Krowinski_1921-2004.txt)
events.quote: This bastard broke my leg in that game.

events.event: Albert William Levi spent a sabbatical year in France.
events.source: Harris interview with Albert William Levi (085_86_Albert_William_Bill_Levi_1911-1988.txt)
events.quote: We spent the fall and a good part of the winter in the South of France.

events.event: Conrad Schmitt studied stained glass with Josef Albers at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Conrad Victor Schmitt (124_128_Conrad_Victor_Schmitt_1927-2014.txt)
events.quote: I went back in '48 then and stayed until '49. Actually, I think I probably stayed until '50.

events.event: Conrad Schmitt created a stained glass crucifixion with Josef Albers.
events.source: Harris interview with Conrad Victor Schmitt (124_128_Conrad_Victor_Schmitt_1927-2014.txt)
events.quote: My one creative work of art in collaboration with Albers was a crucifixion.

events.event: Lore Kadden Lindenfeld worked in the textile industry for ten years.
events.source: Harris interview with Lore Kadden Lindenfeld (159_168_Lore_Kadden_Lindenfeld_1921-2010.txt)
events.quote: Counting Forstmann Woolen, I actually worked in industry for ten years, so I worked probably from '48 to '58 as a designer.

events.event: Jack Rice attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Jack Edward Rice (178_187_Jack_Edward_Rice_1922-2001.txt)
events.quote: I was there in 1948-49 and then we were there in 1952-53.

events.event: Charles Olson visited Black Mountain College once a month.
events.source: Harris interview with Jack Edward Rice (178_187_Jack_Edward_Rice_1922-2001.txt)
events.quote: That year he was coming for one long weekend each month to the college from Washington.

events.event: Performance of Lorca's 'Lament for Ignacio Sánchez Mejías' was presented.
events.source: Harris interview with Jack Edward Rice (178_187_Jack_Edward_Rice_1922-2001.txt)
events.quote: We had it down to what we thought it was a good presentation, and put it on for Olson.

events.event: Stan VanDerBeek and other students became interested in architecture.
events.quote: In the post-war period a number of students on campus became interested in architecture (among them, in 1949, Stan VanDerBeek, the film maker).

events.event: Angelica Bodky Lee's father stayed a whole year at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Angelica Bodky Lee (012_11_Angelica_Bodky_Lee_1929-2012.txt)
events.quote: He stayed a whole year at Black Mountain in ’49.

events.event: Bucky Fuller built a dome at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: That was the next summer that he did that. '49.

events.event: Guy Fielding Dawson attended Black Mountain College for the summer session.
events.source: Harris interview with Guy Fielding 'Fee' Dawson (030_29_Guy_Lewis_Fielding_Fee_Dawson_1930-2002.txt)
events.quote: MEH: So, you came to Black Mountain in the summer of 1949? GFD: Yes. In July.

events.event: Charles Olson taught at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Guy Fielding 'Fee' Dawson (030_29_Guy_Lewis_Fielding_Fee_Dawson_1930-2002.txt)
events.quote: MEH: So, that first summer Olson was teaching? GFD: Yeah.

events.event: Olson was involved in drama productions, including 'Wagadu'.
events.source: Harris interview with Guy Fielding 'Fee' Dawson (030_29_Guy_Lewis_Fielding_Fee_Dawson_1930-2002.txt)
events.quote: MEH: That summer he was really involved in the drama productions is that –? Wagadu? GFD: Well, he was involved with voice that summer.

events.event: Performance involving dance and slide projections with music.
events.source: Harris interview with Guy Fielding 'Fee' Dawson (030_29_Guy_Lewis_Fielding_Fee_Dawson_1930-2002.txt)
events.quote: GFD: I think Pete Jennerjahn played the flute or the – The wooden – What’s it? You know. MEH: Oh, the recorder?

events.event: Theodore Dreier, Jr.'s parents left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Theodore Dreier, Jr. (035_36_Theodore_Dreier_Jr_1929-2019.txt)
events.quote: They left in the spring of ’49, went down to Florida.

events.event: Mary Fitton Fiore arrived at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Mary Fitton Fiore (041_44_Mary_Falconer_Fitton_Fiore_1924-2017.txt)
events.quote: Well, I came February ‘49.

events.event: Bucky Fuller and Emerson Woelffer were at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Mary Fitton Fiore (041_44_Mary_Falconer_Fitton_Fiore_1924-2017.txt)
events.quote: And Bucky Fuller came that summer. And Olson was there. Emerson Woelffer was there.

events.event: Margaret and Alvin Freeman arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Margaret Wooster Freeman (044_47_Margaret_Wooster_Freeman_1923-2019.txt)
events.quote: We arrived in September '49 and left in about September of '50.

events.event: Joe Fiore was involved in a controversy for living with a student.
events.source: Harris interview with Margaret Wooster Freeman (044_47_Margaret_Wooster_Freeman_1923-2019.txt)
events.quote: My favorite was at the time of the great Joe Fiore flap, when he was living with a student – and this was back in '49.

events.event: Cora Kelley Ward enrolled at Black Mountain College for the summer.
events.source: Harris interview with Cora Kelley Ward (046_49_Cora_Kelley_Ward_1920-1989.txt)
events.quote: I decided to enroll for the summer. That was the summer of '49.

events.event: Buckminster Fuller was present at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Cora Kelley Ward (046_49_Cora_Kelley_Ward_1920-1989.txt)
events.quote: That was the summer when Buckminster Fuller... was there?

events.event: Cora Kelley Ward participated in a drawing class with Josef Albers.
events.source: Harris interview with Cora Kelley Ward (046_49_Cora_Kelley_Ward_1920-1989.txt)
events.quote: So this was my first drawing with Albers.

events.event: Olson's drama performance during the summer.
events.source: Harris interview with Mark Hamilton Hedden (059_60_Mark_Hamilton_Hedden_1929-2021.txt)
events.quote: It was partly a carryover from Olson's drama class, or drama performance during the previous summer.

events.event: Joan Heller arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I graduated from Windsor Mountain in '48 and then spent a year at Olivet, so I think I would put it at '49.

events.event: Vollmer Hetherington arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: So you came to Black Mountain in the fall of 1949...

events.event: Felix Krowinski left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Felix Thomas Krowinski (079_80_Felix_Thomas_Krowinski_1921-2004.txt)
events.quote: You were there for one year. You left at the end of the summer.

events.event: Trueman MacHenry arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I was probably the first student at Black Mountain in many years who paid the full tuition.

events.event: Josef Albers left Black Mountain College.
events.quote: Albers had just, just left.

events.event: Ruth Miller Currier joined the José Limón Dance Company.
events.source: Harris interview with Ruth Miller Currier (099_100_Ruth_Miller_Currier_1926-2011.txt)
events.quote: And then in 1949, I guess it was, or ’48, I went to study with José and was just lucky that after I’d been there about three or four months, one of the two women in his company left.

events.event: Neil Noland attended Black Mountain College as a student.
events.quote: in the fall of 1949 I went to Black Mountain College as a student.

events.event: Productions of 'Wagadu' and 'The Cyclops' by Olson
events.source: Harris interview with Andrew "Andy" Francis Oates, Jr. (106_110_Andrew_Andy_Francis_Oates_Jr_1926-2012.txt)
events.quote: Do you remember in the summer of '49, Olson did some productions: 'Wagadu' and 'The Cyclops.'

events.event: Marianne Preger-Simon became Merce Cunningham's first student.
events.quote: So, I was his first student, and I was the only student for a couple of weeks.

events.event: Katharine Rondthaler Woodwell returned to Black Mountain College for the summer session.
events.source: Harris interview with Katharine Rondthaler Woodwell (119_123_Alice_Katharine_Rondthaler_Woodwell_b_1929.txt)
events.quote: No, in '49 Summer Session and '50 Summer Session.

events.event: A significant number of people left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Mirande Geissbuhler Holl (143_149_Mirande_Roxanne_Geissbuhler_Holl_b_1928.txt)
events.quote: Then there was the big breakup and almost three-quarters of the people I guess left...

events.event: Susan Weil attended the Art Students League.
events.source: Harris interview with Susan Weil (Rauschenberg Kirschenbaum) (144_150_Susan_Weil_Rauschenberg_Kirschenbaum_b_1930.txt)
events.quote: I went to the Art Students League and studied with Vytlacil and Kantor.

events.event: Jack Rice left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Jack Edward Rice (178_187_Jack_Edward_Rice_1922-2001.txt)
events.quote: So you left at the end of the '49 summer session?

events.event: Harvey Harmon arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Sample Harmon (184_193_Harvey_Sample_Harmon_1927-2004.txt)
events.quote: Harvey, you came to Black Mountain in 1949?

events.event: Charles Olson arrived at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Sample Harmon (184_193_Harvey_Sample_Harmon_1927-2004.txt)
events.quote: He came, I believe he came in ’49.

events.event: June Rice Lane Christensen arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with June Rice Lane Christensen (191_200_June_Ann_Rice_Lane_Christensen_1926-2017.txt)
events.quote: What was your first year there? JRC: Summer of '49.

events.event: Buckminster Fuller was at Black Mountain College.

events.event: Collapse of the farm at Black Mountain College.
Collapse of the farm at Black Mountain College.
Eleanor Roosevelt visited Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Lucile Patton Bannerman (002_2_Lucile_Patton_Bannerman_1907-1996.txt)
events.quote: This was in the early fifties, and the place was – oh, the weeds had grown up and it just looked in such – so ill-kept.

events.event: Clemens Sandresky acquired music library materials from Black Mountain College.
events.quote: We bought what was left of the library—everything that was left of the library.

events.event: Robert de Niro, Sr. visited Black Mountain College when Charles Olson was there.
events.source: Harris interview with Robert de Niro, Sr. (032_31_Robert_de_Niro_Sr_1922-1993.txt)
events.quote: And that was when Olson, Charles Olson, was there.

events.event: A string quartet was in residence at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Margaret Wooster Freeman (044_47_Margaret_Wooster_Freeman_1923-2019.txt)
events.quote: Vollmer Hetherington did one of the best musical things that was done there, and was – does one say 'instrumental'? – in getting together a string quartet in residence.

events.event: Cora Kelley Ward returned to Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Cora Kelley Ward (046_49_Cora_Kelley_Ward_1920-1989.txt)
events.quote: Then I came back to Black Mountain the following summer.

events.event: Cora Kelley Ward took a course called 'Techniques of Learning' taught by Natasha Goldowski.
events.source: Harris interview with Cora Kelley Ward (046_49_Cora_Kelley_Ward_1920-1989.txt)
events.quote: I see in the schedule here that you took 'Techniques of Learning.'

events.event: Josef Albers appointed to the Yale Art School faculty.
events.quote: Albers while he was still at Black Mountain had been a member of the Yale University Council’s Committee on Art and he was appointed to the Art School faculty in 1950.

events.event: Alvin Eisenman met Josef Albers for the first time.
events.quote: we met for the first time September first, which was a couple of weeks before classes began.

events.event: Mark Hedden took a course with Paul Goodman.
events.source: Harris interview with Mark Hamilton Hedden (059_60_Mark_Hamilton_Hedden_1929-2021.txt)
events.quote: I had taken a course with Goodman in Shakespeare and writing in the summer of 1950.

events.event: Mark Hedden participated in the play 'The Shewing Up of Blanco Posner'.
events.source: Harris interview with Mark Hamilton Hedden (059_60_Mark_Hamilton_Hedden_1929-2021.txt)
events.quote: I was part of the play in 1950, called The Shewing Up of Blanco Posner. Clement Greenberg directed that.

events.event: Leo Amino taught a sculpture class.
events.quote: I also took a sculpture class with Leo Amino in the summer.

events.event: String quartet concerts focusing on contemporary music were held.
events.quote: That summer, though, you had a special string quartet which concentrated on contemporary...

events.event: Vollmer Hetherington left Black Mountain College due to salary cuts.
events.quote: In the fall – I did go back, incidentally, in the fall to find that they had decided to cut salaries...

events.event: Merce Cunningham visited BMC for a week.
events.quote: In the spring of '50 Merce came down for a week.

events.event: First performance by Merce Cunningham's students at Cooper Union.
events.quote: That was our first performance, and we were this junior company.

events.event: Katharine Rondthaler Woodwell returned to Black Mountain College for the summer session.
events.source: Harris interview with Katharine Rondthaler Woodwell (119_123_Alice_Katharine_Rondthaler_Woodwell_b_1929.txt)
events.quote: No, in '49 Summer Session and '50 Summer Session.

events.event: Adele Suska LaBreque arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Adele Suska LaBreque (138_144_Adele_Suska_LaBreque_1927-2021.txt)
events.quote: I got there in the fall of 1950.

events.event: Explosion of interest in pottery began
events.quote: I think it flowered in the sixties but it started in the fifties.

events.event: Pottery seminar at BMC with Voulkos and Dan Rhodes
events.quote: That summer, you know, we had Voulkos come and Dan Rhodes and all...

events.event: Construction of an addition to the pot shop
events.quote: Yeah. Yeah, with Jack Rice.

events.event: Performance of 'Blood Wedding' at BMC
events.quote: I remember Blood Wedding was pretty good.

events.event: Jacqueline attended Black Mountain College summer session.
events.source: Harris interview with Jacqueline Herrmann Gourevitch (164_173_Jacqueline_Herrmann_Gourevitch_b_1933.txt)
events.quote: Well, it was summer session of 1950, at which point I was still sixteen...

events.event: First visit to Black Mountain College with M.C. Richards and David Tudor.
events.quote: I think it was—the first time I went down was at Thanksgiving.

events.event: David Corkran's family left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with David Hudson Corkran (171_180_David_Hudson_Corkran_b_1935.txt)
events.quote: We left the college in 1950 after my freshman year in high school.

events.event: Cynthia Homire first attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Cynthia Kirk Homire Metcalf (Fick) (174_183_Cynthia_Kirk_Homire_Metcalf_Fick_1931-2019.txt)
events.quote: I have you as entering in the spring semester, not in the fall, in the spring of 1950.

events.event: Glenn Edwin Lewis attended summer school at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Glenn Edwin Lewis (179_188_Glenn_Edwin_Lewis_1926-2021.txt)
events.quote: So, in the summer of '50, I had finished my Master's in mathematics and wanted very much if I could see Jack again, and so I took off for Black Mountain.

events.event: Glenn Edwin Lewis participated in a play called 'Blanco Posnet' as the sheriff.
events.location: Dining room at Black Mountain College
events.source: Harris interview with Glenn Edwin Lewis (179_188_Glenn_Edwin_Lewis_1926-2021.txt)
events.quote: The one thing I did during the summer was I was part of the play.

events.event: Glenn Edwin Lewis took sculpture courses with Leo Amino.
events.source: Harris interview with Glenn Edwin Lewis (179_188_Glenn_Edwin_Lewis_1926-2021.txt)
events.quote: I took sculpture from Amino. I thought he was wonderful and I loved the work that he did.

events.event: Glenn Edwin Lewis took a literature course with Paul Goodman.
events.source: Harris interview with Glenn Edwin Lewis (179_188_Glenn_Edwin_Lewis_1926-2021.txt)
events.quote: I took a course from Paul on literature.

events.event: June Rice Lane Christensen left Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with June Rice Lane Christensen (191_200_June_Ann_Rice_Lane_Christensen_1926-2017.txt)
events.quote: I was there that summer, then the school year, and then the summer of '50. That's when I left.

events.event: Katy Litz taught dance at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with June Rice Lane Christensen (191_200_June_Ann_Rice_Lane_Christensen_1926-2017.txt)
events.quote: Katy Litz came in the summer of '50, that summer, and then you went back with her.

events.event: Merrill Gillespie arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: Was in 1950 that you arrived? '50, yes.

events.event: First visit to Black Mountain College with M.C. Richards and David Tudor.
events.quote: I got there the first time when M.C. Richards and David Tudor drove down together...

events.event: Viola Farber arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I went in the fall of '51, I think.

events.event: Charles Olson returned to BMC from Yucatán.
events.source: Harris interview with Mary Fitton Fiore (041_44_Mary_Falconer_Fitton_Fiore_1924-2017.txt)
events.quote: He came back the summer of ’52 [‘51], and he had – He came back from the Yucatán to Black Mountain.

events.event: Suzi Gablik attended Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I was only sixteen years old. I had just graduated from high school.

events.event: Ben Shahn taught at Black Mountain College for four weeks.
events.quote: He was only there for the first month.

events.event: Suzi Gablik started writing poetry under the influence of Charles Olson.
events.quote: I started to write my first poems there.

events.event: Suzi Gablik took a course in Russian with Madame Goldowski.
events.quote: I took a course in Russian.

events.event: John Hamilton visited Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth 'Libby' Fant Hamilton (055_56_Elizabeth_Libby_Fant_Hamilton_1924-2003.txt)
events.quote: John visited the college and was there a summer before I was...

events.event: Birth of Elizabeth Hamilton's son.
events.source: Harris interview with Elizabeth 'Libby' Fant Hamilton (055_56_Elizabeth_Libby_Fant_Hamilton_1924-2003.txt)
events.quote: My son was born October the 13th in '51...

events.event: Tommy Jackson arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: That's when I got there. I'm surprised at that.

events.event: Jonathan Williams arrived at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: Jonathan Williams probably came in that same summer, '51.

events.event: Charles Olson returned to Black Mountain College.
events.quote: Olson came back in the fall of '51.

events.event: Tommy Jackson worked in the Print Shop at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I ended up in the Print Shop a lot, and I did spend a lot of time at that.

events.event: The first issue of The Black Mountain College Review was printed.
events.quote: The first thing of any significance was the premier issue of The Black Mountain College Review.

events.event: Basil King attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Basil "Baz" King and Martha Davis King (076_77_Basil_Baz_King_b_1935_and_Martha_Davis_King_b_1937.txt)
events.quote: It was 51. I mean, it’s silly.

interview_source.interviewee: Basil "Baz" King and Martha Davis King

events.event: Selma Weisberger MacHenry attended Black Mountain College for summer school.
events.quote: That was the summer of '51.

events.event: Ben Shahn and Robert Motherwell were at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: That was the summer of Ben Shahn and Robert Motherwell were there.

events.event: Graduation of Andy Oates from Black Mountain College
events.source: Harris interview with Andrew "Andy" Francis Oates, Jr. (106_110_Andrew_Andy_Francis_Oates_Jr_1926-2012.txt)
events.quote: Your graduation was at the end of the three years. About '51.

events.event: Wanda Shult Austin and Charles Jackson separated.
events.source: Harris interview with Wanda Belle Shult Austin (129_133_Wanda_Belle_Shult_Austin_1925-2006.txt)
events.quote: Charlie and I parted company within the first year we were here, and he went up to Chicago.

events.event: Robert Motherwell was artist-in-residence at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Adele Suska LaBreque (138_144_Adele_Suska_LaBreque_1927-2021.txt)
events.quote: Robert Motherwell was sort of the artist-in-residence.

events.event: Ben Shahn was present at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Adele Suska LaBreque (138_144_Adele_Suska_LaBreque_1927-2021.txt)
events.quote: Then the other person that was there was Ben Shahn.

events.event: Merce Cunningham and John Cage were at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Adele Suska LaBreque (138_144_Adele_Suska_LaBreque_1927-2021.txt)
events.quote: Merce Cunningham came down midway... John Cage, yeah.

events.event: Modern dance festival at Chapel Hill.
events.source: Harris interview with Adele Suska LaBreque (138_144_Adele_Suska_LaBreque_1927-2021.txt)
events.quote: There was Nick. There was Fielding – the fellow who – Oh, Tim LaFarge.

events.event: Performance by Tudor of Music of Changes, Part 1
events.quote: A program for August 19 [1951] lists a performance by Tudor of Music of Changes, Part 1.

events.event: Susan Weil returned to Black Mountain College for a summer session.
events.source: Harris interview with Susan Weil (Rauschenberg Kirschenbaum) (144_150_Susan_Weil_Rauschenberg_Kirschenbaum_b_1930.txt)
events.quote: I went back for the summer, one summer session.

events.event: Lou Harrison came to Black Mountain College.
events.quote: Lou didn't come until M.C. Richards got in touch with him... he came somewhere around '51.

events.event: Start of Spring Semester 1951
events.details: Spring semester runs from February 7 to June 13.

events.event: Start of Spring Vacation
events.details: Spring vacation from March 28 to April 8.

events.details: Courses in verse: Mayan Hieroglyphic Writing and Ovid’s Metamorphoses.

events.event: Katherine Litz composes new works at Black Mountain College
events.details: Composed two new works with music by Lou Harrison.

events.event: Lou Harrison composes new music for dance at Black Mountain College
events.details: New music includes Chorales for Springs and The Glyph and piece for 2 pianos.

events.event: Publication of The Black Mountain College Review Vol.1 No.1
events.details: The first volume of The Black Mountain College Review was published, featuring contributions from faculty and students.

events.event: Summer session focusing on photography, painting, and dance.
events.details: The session will stress photography, painting, and dance with specific faculty assigned to each discipline.

events.details: A performance showcasing various pieces involving light, sound, and movement.

events.event: Faculty disintegration at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: And when, in the spring of 1951, the faculty further disintegrated, this time more or less amicably, M.C. played a decisive role in new recruitment.

events.author: Unknown
events.farm_info: None

events.event: Tasker Howard died.
events.source: Harris interview with Lorna Blaine Howard Halper (009_9_Lorna_Blaine_Howard_Halper_1924-2012.txt)
events.quote: He died in '52.

events.event: John Cage's 'happening' took place and he read The Huang Po Doctrine of Universal Mind.
events.quote: It was that summer that Cage’s 'happening' took place and that he read the The Huang Po Doctrine of Universal Mind.

events.event: Nick Cernovich performed a dance to 'St. Francis and the birds'.
events.quote: Performed the summer that Ben Shahn was there...

events.event: Studied with Katy Litz and started to dance with her company.
events.quote: I was there for a summer with Katy Litz. I studied with her.

events.event: Performance of 'Occuptoire de Brunhilde' with Katy Litz and Merce Cunningham.
events.quote: I know Katy was there, because they did that Occuptoire de Brunhilde...

events.event: John Cage taught at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: John taught in '52...

events.event: Merce Cunningham taught at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I went back that summer because Merce was coming to teach.

events.event: John Cage's first theatre piece was performed.
events.quote: Did you attend what has come to be known as Cage's first theatre piece?

events.event: Seminar by Bernard Leach, Hamada, and Yanagi at BMC
events.source: Harris interview with John Pike Grady (047_50_John_Pike_Grady_1925-2008.txt)
events.quote: They came to Black Mountain and put on their seminar, their workshop.

events.event: Franz Kline visited BMC
events.source: Harris interview with John Pike Grady (047_50_John_Pike_Grady_1925-2008.txt)
events.quote: Franz Kline was the one that I—they all were very open.

events.event: David Tudor performed at BMC
events.source: Harris interview with John Pike Grady (047_50_John_Pike_Grady_1925-2008.txt)
events.quote: He was blindingly fast on a keyboard.

events.event: Joan Heller left Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I was there until 1952.

events.event: Paul Goodman visited BMC to examine someone for graduation.
events.quote: In the spring of '52, Paul Goodman came down to the college to examine someone for graduation.

events.event: Harvey Lichtenstein attended Black Mountain College.
events.quote: According to my records, you were at Black Mountain in the summer of 1952.

events.event: John Cage, Merce Cunningham, and David Tudor organized a Happening.
events.quote: It was involving John Cage, Merce, and David Tudor.

events.event: Harvey Lichtenstein worked on the farm to pay for his stay.
events.quote: I began to work out on the farm to sort of pay for it.

events.event: Trueman MacHenry and Selma Weisberger MacHenry got married.
events.quote: '52 – because '53 we were married in –

events.event: Franz Kline was at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: '52 was when Kline was there.

events.event: Franz Kline was a resident artist at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with William Douglas McGee (098_99_William_Douglas_McGee_1925-1999.txt)
events.quote: I learned he was going to be resident artist there in the summer of '52.

events.event: William McGee attended BMC with financial help.
events.source: Harris interview with William Douglas McGee (098_99_William_Douglas_McGee_1925-1999.txt)
events.quote: They gave me a kind of a—I guess you could call it a kind of scholarship.

events.event: John Cage and Merce Cunningham were present and performed.
events.source: Harris interview with William Douglas McGee (098_99_William_Douglas_McGee_1925-1999.txt)
events.quote: Cage was playing that concert... Merce Cunningham was there dancing.

events.event: A 'happening' event took place at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with William Douglas McGee (098_99_William_Douglas_McGee_1925-1999.txt)
events.quote: This was the 'happening'? This was the one that Duberman spent a lot of time talking about in his book.

events.event: Michael Rumaker visited Black Mountain College for the first time.
events.source: Harris interview with Michael J. Rumaker (121_125_Michael_J_Rumaker_1932-2019.txt)
events.quote: We visited in the summer of '52. Olson was there then and we talked.

events.event: Michael Rumaker started as a work scholarship student at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Michael J. Rumaker (121_125_Michael_J_Rumaker_1932-2019.txt)
events.quote: I came back in September as a work scholarship student.

events.event: Rupert Schmitt was drafted into the army.
events.source: Harris interview with Rupert Peter Schmitt (125_129_Rupert_Peter_Schmitt_b_1932.txt)
events.quote: I was drafted in 1952.

events.event: Adele Suska LaBreque returned to BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Adele Suska LaBreque (138_144_Adele_Suska_LaBreque_1927-2021.txt)
events.quote: Then I went away and then I came back for the summer of '52.

events.event: Concert featuring John Cage’s Music of Changes, four parts
events.quote: Two concerts were scheduled for August 9 and 11, 1952. The first on August 9 lists John Cage’s Music of Changes, four parts.

events.event: Performance of Two Pastorales and Water Music by Cage
events.quote: The date for the second concert was changed in ink from August 11 to August 12. [1952]. There are two compositions listed by Cage: Two Pastorales and August 12, 1952 (i.e., Water Music).

events.event: Performance of Solo Suite In Time and Space by Cage, danced by Cunningham
events.quote: Solo Suite In Time and Space by Cage was performed by Tudor and danced by Cunningham on August 22, 1952.

events.event: Tudor was accompanist for Tim LaFarge’s graduation program in dance
events.quote: Tudor was accompanist for Tim LaFarge’s graduation program in dance on March 9, 1952.

events.event: David Weinrib and Karen Karnes became potters-in-residence at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: We were just potters-in-residence.

events.event: Franz Kline, Jack Tworkov, and Stefan Wolpe were present at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: That was the summer that Kline was there, Tworkov.

events.event: A 'happening' performance took place involving John Cage, Merce Cunningham, and others.
events.quote: Of course, that was the year of the first 'happening,' you know, when they did that large performance together.

events.event: Vera Baker Williams worked on building an A-frame house.
events.source: Harris interview with Vera Baker Williams (150_157_Vera_Baker_Williams_1927-2015.txt)
events.quote: So, just sort of working out chronology here, that was just the summer of '52 you were working – The spring and summer of '52 you were working on the house.

events.event: Participated in a Wagnerian opera spoof with Franz Kline.
events.quote: It was at the third visit, and he was there when we did that play that, kind of a parody of a Wagnerian opera.

events.event: Pottery seminar with Yanagi and Hamada at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Cynthia Kirk Homire Metcalf (Fick) (174_183_Cynthia_Kirk_Homire_Metcalf_Fick_1931-2019.txt)
events.quote: The fall of ’52 was when they had the pottery seminar.

events.event: Franz Kline was at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Cynthia Kirk Homire Metcalf (Fick) (174_183_Cynthia_Kirk_Homire_Metcalf_Fick_1931-2019.txt)
events.quote: I was there the summer that Kline was there.

events.event: Ronald Robertson attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Ronald George Robertson (177_186_Ronald_George_Robertson_1927-2022.txt)
events.quote: I enrolled and spent the summer and then a fall there also.

events.event: Ronald Robertson participated in cutting down pine trees for pulpwood to help the school financially.
events.source: Harris interview with Ronald George Robertson (177_186_Ronald_George_Robertson_1927-2022.txt)
events.quote: Carl Kent and I got the school to buy us some big two-bladed axes, and we started hacking pine trees down.

events.event: Ronald Robertson participated in a play, Kafka's 'The Trial'.
events.source: Harris interview with Ronald George Robertson (177_186_Ronald_George_Robertson_1927-2022.txt)
events.quote: I did participate in one play. It was Kafka's play, The Trial?

events.event: David Tudor composed music for a play at Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Ronald George Robertson (177_186_Ronald_George_Robertson_1927-2022.txt)
events.quote: David Tudor. Anyway, he had composed the music for the play.

events.event: Jack Rice returned to Black Mountain College to be director of the Work Program.
events.source: Harris interview with Jack Edward Rice (178_187_Jack_Edward_Rice_1922-2001.txt)
events.quote: But you went back to be director of the Work Program.

events.event: Fire destroyed the house where Joe and Mary Fiore lived.
events.source: Harris interview with Jack Edward Rice (178_187_Jack_Edward_Rice_1922-2001.txt)
events.quote: It had been discovered that the house way at the far end of the property that Joe and Mary Fiore had been living in had caught fire.

events.event: Summer session with Kline, Cage, and Cunningham.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Sample Harmon (184_193_Harvey_Sample_Harmon_1927-2004.txt)
events.quote: Cage and Cunningham were there that summer.

events.event: Harvey Harmon left BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Harvey Sample Harmon (184_193_Harvey_Sample_Harmon_1927-2004.txt)
events.quote: You stayed through that summer and then through the fall, I believe, and then you left.

events.event: Deborah Sussman attended Black Mountain College.
events.source: Harris interview with Deborah Evelyn Sussman (185_194_Deborah_Evelyn_Sussman_1931-2014.txt)
events.quote: You were at Black Mountain in the summer of 1952?

events.event: Merce Cunningham and John Cage were present at BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Deborah Evelyn Sussman (185_194_Deborah_Evelyn_Sussman_1931-2014.txt)
events.quote: Cunningham and the whole Cunningham group was cohering.

events.event: Deborah Sussman studied with Franz Kline.
events.source: Harris interview with Deborah Evelyn Sussman (185_194_Deborah_Evelyn_Sussman_1931-2014.txt)
events.quote: Very intensely with Franz Kline, and also with Merce and John.

events.event: John Cage staged what is now known as the first Happening.
events.source: Harris interview with Deborah Evelyn Sussman (185_194_Deborah_Evelyn_Sussman_1931-2014.txt)
events.quote: Do you remember what has now come to be known as the first Happening that John Cage staged at Black Mountain?

events.event: John Cage and Merce Cunningham performed a Happening at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I was there during the – I guess it was a summer when John and Merce did that first Happening...

events.details: Registration on September 22, Classes begin on September 23

events.event: Caresse Crosby visited BMC.
events.source: Harris interview with Mary Fitton Fiore (041_44_Mary_Falconer_Fitton_Fiore_1924-2017.txt)
events.quote: Do you remember a visit by Caresse Crosby? Yeah. Oh, yeah. I remember it very well.

events.event: Founded Friends of Nature
events.quote: I founded an international conservation organization named Friends of Nature. That was founded in 1954.

events.event: Helen Hellman participated in theater activities at Black Mountain College.
events.quote: My great interest in Black Mountain really was what I did that first summer in theater with Wesley Huss.

events.event: Rehearsed reading of Uncle Vanya was performed.
events.quote: Wes put on a rehearsed reading of Uncle Vanya. Robert was Vanya, I was Sonia.

events.event: Performance of Peer Gynt took place.
events.quote: Peer Gynt that we did. That was the last thing, and that was, that was really fun.

events.event: Eli Leon attended Black Mountain College.
events.quote: I must have turned nineteen that summer at Black Mountain.

events.event: Eli Leon took a writing class with Charles Olson.
events.quote: I signed up for something from Charles Olson...

events.event: Eli Leon took a lithography class with Joe Fiore.
events.quote: Then I took a lithography class from – what's the guy's name, he had an Italian name, I think.

events.event: Eli Leon worked in the pottery studio with Karen Karnes.
events.quote: I was particularly interested in studying with Karen Karnes.

events.event: Eli Leon participated in a reading of a novel by Hellman.
events.quote: He had a novel he was writing, and we did a reading.

events.event: Summary of information on Black Mountain College

events.event: Start of Spring Quarter
events.details: The Spring Quarter opens on March 29th and runs through June 12th.

events.event: Start of Summer Quarter

events.event: Start of Fall Quarter
